verdict.rationale: Real-time expense coding (merchant, category, memo, receipt capture) is a fair question for a corporate card like ernd, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only rewards rates, partner perks, travel redemption, card requests and the app. Nothing documents transaction categorization, memos, receipt matching, or accounting/close workflows.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig
